beats.quote: I just want her to come to me first.

beats.line: A horrible message in the group chat.

beats.me: She showed me a horrible message from a group chat. What do I say?

digi: Right now: tell her you are glad she came to you. She did nothing wrong.
Next: ask her to show you, in her own words, before you decide anything.
This week: tell me how it goes, and I will check back.

beats.line: DiGi checks back on what it suggested.
She came to you, not around you.
